title: Reviews & Ratings
description: Learn how to manage product reviews and ratings, moderate customer feedback, and build trust with social proof.
content:
Reviews & Ratings

Product reviews and ratings help build trust, improve SEO, and provide valuable feedback. Manage reviews effectively to maximize their impact.

Review System Overview

The review system allows customers to:

  • Rate products (1-5 stars)
  • Write detailed reviews
  • Upload photos
  • Help other customers decide

Review Settings

Configure review settings:

  • Enable/disable reviews
  • Require purchase to review
  • Require approval before publishing
  • Allow anonymous reviews
  • Enable photo uploads

Managing Reviews

Viewing Reviews

Access reviews from:

  • Products → Reviews
  • Individual product pages
  • Reviews dashboard

Moderating Reviews

Review management options:

  • Approve reviews
  • Reject reviews
  • Edit review content
  • Delete reviews
  • Mark as featured

Responding to Reviews

Respond to customer reviews:

  • Thank customers for positive reviews
  • Address concerns in negative reviews
  • Show you value feedback
  • Build customer relationships

Review Display

Configure how reviews appear:

  • Show on product pages
  • Display rating stars
  • Show review count
  • Sort reviews (newest, highest rated)
  • Filter reviews
  • Pagination

Review Moderation

Moderate reviews to maintain quality:

  • Review content for appropriateness
  • Check for spam
  • Verify authenticity
  • Ensure relevance

Review Analytics

Track review performance:

  • Average rating per product
  • Total reviews
  • Review response rate
  • Most reviewed products
  • Review trends

Encouraging Reviews

Get more reviews:

  • Send follow-up emails after purchase
  • Offer incentives for reviews
  • Make review process easy
  • Respond to all reviews
  • Showcase reviews on homepage

Handling Negative Reviews

Manage negative reviews effectively:

  • Respond promptly and professionally
  • Address concerns directly
  • Offer solutions
  • Take conversation offline if needed
  • Learn from feedback

Review SEO Benefits

Reviews help with SEO:

  • Fresh content on product pages
  • Long-tail keywords
  • User-generated content
  • Structured data (review schema)
  • Increased engagement

Best Practices

  • Enable reviews on all products
  • Moderate reviews regularly
  • Respond to reviews promptly
  • Encourage honest reviews
  • Use reviews in marketing
  • Monitor review trends

Related Guides

  • SEO Settings
